title: steps block props
description: A steps block (« Étapes »): a process, a procedure or a story told in order, as items with a title and a text. Not the screen's steps (a screen's steps pace its blocks with Continue); a steps block is one block whose items the learner goes through. Presentations: carousel (one step at a time with Previous and Next, an optional intro and summary; Rise's process), timeline (« Frise »: the steps one under the other on a line, each with its date) and scroll (« Défilé »: the text scrolls while a figure stays in view beside it and changes with the step that crosses the middle of the window; native scroll, the page is never held). In slides a scroll steps block shows its steps one under the other, each with its picture.
x-ai-instructions: Use a steps block for what happens in order: three to seven steps (W_ITEMS_MANY over seven in a carousel), each a title of a few words (about 23 characters) and two or three sentences (120 to 270 characters). carousel: a process to follow; give it an intro (what the process is for) and a summary (what to remember) when it has more than three steps. timeline: dated events (date on every item). scroll: a figure that changes with the text; figure replace (each step's image in turn), build (each step's image a transparent layer over figureImage, stacking up) or focus (one figureImage, each step's region outlined). Each image needs alt unless decorative. In slides prefer carousel: a scroll steps block shows its steps one under the other there (W_STEPS_SCROLL_SLIDES). Never call it « Étapes » steps of the screen: those are screen.steps.

presentation.description: carousel: one step at a time, Previous and Next, the intro and summary first and last; timeline: the steps one under the other on a line, their date before them; scroll: the text scrolls beside a figure that follows it (above it, a picture per step, in narrow places, in slides and with less motion).

id.description: Stable id of the step: its visited mark and its translations name it. Not intro nor summary (the carousel's first and last items).

title.description: The step in a few words.

markdown.description: What happens at this step: two or three sentences.

image.description: A picture of the step. scroll: the figure while this step is current (replace), or the layer it adds over figureImage (build: a transparent PNG or SVG the size of figureImage).

alt.description: What the picture shows (build: the figure once this layer is added). Required with an image unless decorative is true.

decorative.description: True when the picture carries no information beyond the text.

date.description: timeline: when (a year, a date, « Jour 1 », « T+30 min »), shown before the title.

region.description: scroll with figure focus: the part of figureImage this step is about, from 0 to 1 of the whole picture (x, y: its top left corner; w, h: its width and height). The figure outlines it and dims the rest.

x.description: Left edge, from the picture's left (0) to its right (1).

y.description: Top edge, from the picture's top (0) to its bottom (1).

w.description: Width, as a share of the picture's width.

h.description: Height, as a share of the picture's height.

intro.description: carousel: the first item, before the steps (what the process is for, what to look for). The sequence's item intro.

alt.description: What the picture shows; empty: decorative.

summary.description: carousel: the last item, after the steps (what to remember). The sequence's item summary: reaching it means every step was shown.

alt.description: What the picture shows; empty: decorative.

numbered.description: carousel and scroll: each step shows its number (the intro and the summary have none).

figure.description: scroll: how the figure follows the steps. replace: each step's image replaces the one before (a cross-fade; a step without image keeps it); build: each step's image is a layer added over figureImage, step n showing layers 1 to n; focus: figureImage alone, each step's region outlined and the rest dimmed.

figureImage.description: scroll: the base of the figure (build: under the layers; focus: the picture whose regions the steps outline).

figureAlt.description: What figureImage shows. Required with figureImage.

side.description: scroll: where the figure sits beside the text on wide places (end: after it, on the right in a left-to-right language; start: before it).
